objective: Candidate turns a pizza in an oven; PR-2209 closes and seals a preloaded carton using material pulled from an ordinary tape roll.
physical_skill: Candidate requires long-peel steering and low-lift food traction; PR-2209 requires flap folding, tape-roll handling, controlled payout, pressure bonding, end wrapping, and cutter use.
success_condition: Candidate requires a released half-turn with continuous deck support, limited translation, integrity, and tool withdrawal. PR-2209 scores connected tape coverage, complete seam and end wraps, a blade-cut strip, retained closure, parked tools, and contained products.
reason: The tasks share generic tool use but their contact mechanics and successful physical outcomes are unrelated.
